title: fix: #5974 keep table column tools inside the editor viewport
issueTitle: [Bug] 当编辑内容停留在表格位置，鼠标向上移动悬停到文件tab时，表格快捷编辑横条会遮挡tab，容易误操作和无法操作tab
why: The bug is about the table toolbar overlapping the file tab bar when the mouse hovers there, which is a visual layout and hover-position problem with no clear text to check, and the test starts with only one file open, so there is no other tab to try to click.
